blocks.text: Purging separates training observations from test windows so overlapping labels cannot leak. The task is: Build expanding walk-forward splits for test index blocks (start,stop). Train only on earlier rows whose label end time is strictly before first test feature time minus gap; all times share numeric units and are sorted.

The inputs are `feature_times`, `label_end_times`, `test_blocks`, `gap`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.

Before following the implementation, identify the output's shape and meaning. Then identify which input values can affect one selected output. This gives you a testable mental model before the code adds implementation detail.
What changes in the boundary case

Train only on earlier rows whose label end time is strictly before first test feature time minus gap; all times share numeric units and are sorted. Use the Trace control to switch between the normal path and this boundary focus. The algorithm does not get permission to invent an unstated fallback.

A useful test changes one condition while holding the remaining inputs fixed. Compare the output shape, state transition, valid edges, selected tokens, or returned status. This isolates the reason for the change.
